description: Build templates 31-40: Food/beverage and restaurant categories. Each must have distinct appetizing layouts.
steps: Create templates/fast-food-promotion/ - Fast-food product offer with bold red/yellow energy and combo layout
Create templates/lemon-soda-promotion/ - Beverage splash ad with dynamic liquid splash effect via CSS shapes
Create templates/healthy-food-promotion/ - Healthy meal campaign with fresh green palette and ingredient grid
Create templates/fresh-juice/ - Juice/product splash with fruit arrangement and glass centerpiece
Create templates/pizza-notification/ - Pizza offer with circular pizza image area and hot deal badge
Create templates/breakfast-burger/ - Breakfast combo with layered ingredients visual and meal deal
Create templates/cake-bakery/ - Bakery product hero with elegant script typography and cake showcase
Create templates/pancake-pastries/ - Dessert promotion with stack visual and toppings grid
Create templates/sushi-restaurant/ - Restaurant menu hero with Japanese-inspired grid and plate arrangement
Create templates/steak-delivery/ - Delivery conversion ad with grill marks visual and order CTA
Each template MUST include: manifest.json, layout-1x1.html, assets/, thumb.png, BUILD-NOTES.md
Food templates should feel appetizing with warm tones; each must have unique composition
acceptance_criteria: 40 total template directories exist under templates/
No JavaScript in any HTML file
All CSS uses only semantic variables
All text nodes have data-role and data-importance
verification: ls templates/ | wc -l should show at least 40
findings: All 10 food/beverage templates created with distinct compositions: fast-food uses red/yellow energy + starburst price, lemon-soda uses warped border-radius splash shapes, healthy-food uses white/green + 4-column ingredient grid, fresh-juice uses radial fruit orbits around center glass, pizza uses checkered pattern + dashed circle, breakfast-burger uses exploded vertical ingredient stack, cake-bakery uses ornate double border + corner flourishes + italic script, pancake-pastries uses stacked rounded rectangles + syrup drips + topping chips, sushi-restaurant uses asymmetric grid + triangle plate arrangement, steak-delivery uses grill-line repeating-linear-gradient + full-width CTA.
